page.overview:
What is Walrein?

It is a portly blue walrus Pokémon with long tusks. Wide flippers and tail form most of its locomotive ability; its body is large and seemingly cannot be fully supported with its flippers.

It is insulated against the cold by its thick layer of blubber. This layer of fat also protects it from enemy attacks by causing them to bounce off. It can coat its body in ice and charge opponents to use its former signature move, Ice Ball. While its long tusks are capable of crushing ice up to 10 tons in one blow, they may break during battle. This Pokémon can be found in herds, which are fiercely protected by the leader. The leader is willing to give up its life in order to protect the herd. A herd of Walrein usually consists of 20 to 30 individuals. Whenever Walrein's impressive tusks break during battle, they always grow back every year.

Walrein evolves from Sealeo starting at level 44 and is the final evolution of Spheal.

Walrein made its first appearance under the ownership Team Aqua's grunt in Fight for the Meteorite.
